purpose: Enumerate every destination the built application can contact at runtime, so that a later witness unit can block them deliberately instead of discovering them in a browser.
method: Static read of the reconciled source at the pinned revision: a regex sweep for http(s) URLs across src/, e2e/ and test/, followed by reading each hit in context. No browser was driven and no request was made.

backend.detail: There is no server source in this repository. Persistence is browser localStorage. The Dockerfile builds an nginx image that serves the already-built dist/ as static files and defines no API.

destinations.trigger: unconditional, on every page load of every build variant
destinations.purpose: the Material Icons ligature font used by every <mat-icon> in the interface
destinations.witnessPosture: must be blocked and its absence declared. Under a blocked request the application still boots; each icon renders as its ligature text (for example the literal `open_in_browser`) instead of a glyph. This is a visible-but-non-fatal degradation and must not be silently masked.
destinations.priorArt: the harness-angular-realworld-fonts work in this corpus met the same class of problem

destinations.trigger: only in a build that ships the ngsw service worker — that is, the repository's build-prod-lang chain, not a plain `ng build --prod`
destinations.purpose: the service worker is configured to cache the external font stylesheet
destinations.witnessPosture: a blocked font request in a service-worker build fails inside the worker's install or fetch path rather than in the page. Any witness of the dist/en variant must state which of the two build variants it is driving.

destinations.trigger: user-initiated only, and only after an API key is supplied — through the /configureautotranslate page at runtime or through the git-ignored src/environments/environment.secret.ts at build time
destinations.purpose: the optional auto-translate journey and its summary report
destinations.credentialInFixture: none. environment.ts and environment.prod.ts both set googletranslate_api_key to null, and neither environment.secret.ts nor googleTranslateApiKey.txt exists in the tree; both are git-ignored upstream.
destinations.witnessPosture: out of the local-only closure. Block it, do not supply a key, and do not drive the auto-translate journey as part of a local witness.

documentationOnlyLinks.note: These appear in the tree but are never fetched by the application.

scoutClaimNotReconciled.claim: an optional GitHub-download feature to be blocked at witness time (record the destination)
scoutClaimNotReconciled.finding: No such feature exists at this revision. The only path by which a translation file enters the application is the local file input in src/app/project-starter/project-starter.component.html, read through FileReader.readAsText in AsynchronousFileReaderService. There is no fetch, no XMLHttpRequest and no HttpClient call anywhere in the tree that retrieves a translation file from a remote host; the single HttpClient consumer is the Google auto-translate service.
scoutClaimNotReconciled.consequence: There is no GitHub destination to block. The destination that does need blocking, and that the scout did not name, is the Material Icons stylesheet on fonts.googleapis.com.
scoutClaimNotReconciled.state: recorded as not-reconciled rather than assumed present

localStorageSurface.keys: one key per project, plus a current-project id and a current-translation-unit id
localStorageSurface.indexedDb: none — the API does not appear anywhere in the tree
localStorageSurface.witnessNote: localStorage is the entire persistence surface a witness must clear between runs.

nonclaims: This is a static enumeration. It establishes no observed network behavior, because no browser was driven and no request was made by this unit.
Absence of a destination from this list is evidence of a static read, not proof that the built bundle makes no other request.
